citation.quote: Moderate K+ 6.0–6.4 mmol/l: Clinically unwell or AKI - Assess and treat in hospital; Unexpected result - Repeat within 24 hours. Severe K+ ≥6.5 mmol/l: Take immediate action to assess and treat. Assessment will include blood testing and electrocardiogram monitoring
